# Everyday Performance OS

> A habit and fitness app built for the busiest people alive. Short workouts and simple
> daily habits you can finish on a packed day, with streaks, XP, and a plan that adjusts
> after a missed day. Free to start, no card. Pro is an optional upgrade.

Everyday Performance (everydayperform.com) helps busy people — parents, professionals,
entrepreneurs, and anyone whose schedule never stays perfect — stay consistent. The core
idea is **consistency over perfection**: showing up on your worst day matters more than a
perfect week.

## What it does
- **Daily habits**: pick a few small habits and log them each day; streaks forgive a missed day.
- **Short workouts**: train in the time you have, with sets, RPE, duration, notes, and an exercise library.
- **Guided plans**: a day-by-day plan that tells you what to do and can restart after a miss.
- **Progress**: streaks, XP, badges, levels, a consistency calendar, and weekly recaps.
- **Community**: friends, squads, and weekly leagues for accountability.
- **Coaching**: coaches and clients work out of the same app — coaches assign programs, message
  clients two ways, run weekly check-ins (energy, adherence, notes), and track each client's
  workouts, habits, and streaks.

## Platforms
- Web app and an iOS app (App Store).

## Pricing
- **Free** to start — a daily plan with habits and short workouts, no card required.
- **Pro**: **$14.99/month** or **$149.99/year** (about $12.50/month effective), each with a
  **7-day free trial**. The trial requires a card and auto-renews unless cancelled.
- On the web, billing is via Stripe; on iPhone, the App Store price shown in the app applies.
  Coach plans are a separate purchase and are not consumer Pro.

## Who it's for
Busy people at any level — beginners, parents, professionals — who have bounced off other
fitness and habit apps and want a simple, forgiving system that rewards showing up.

## Links
- Website: https://everydayperform.com/
- App: https://app.everydayperform.com/
- Support: support@everydayperform.com
